sentences.en: Hydrogen, carbon, nitrogen, phosphorus, oxygen, sulfur and selenium are nonmetals.
sentences.zh: 氢、碳、氮、磷、氧、硫和硒是非金属元素。

sentences.en: The green plants take in carbon dioxide from the atmosphere.
sentences.zh: 绿色植物会从大气中吸收二氧化碳。

sentences.en: This company plans to become carbon neutral within five years.
sentences.zh: 该公司计划在五年内实现碳中和。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：carb（碳）+on（表物质结构成分）→碳
